name: @medienreaktor/neos-studio-example-plugins
comment: The plugin API TYPES come from the shell's generated Resources/Public/Studio/types/index.d.ts, mapped to '@medienreaktor/neos-studio' in tsconfig.json paths; at runtime it and react/react-dom are marked external in vite.config.ts and resolved from the shell's copy on window (see src/main.tsx). Keep react majors aligned with the host so types match.
